<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 520" width="640" height="520">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- left beaker with zinc solution -->
  <rect x="40" y="300" width="200" height="120" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <path d="M40 240 V420 H240 V240" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="300" x2="240" y2="300" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- right beaker with copper solution -->
  <rect x="400" y="300" width="200" height="120" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <path d="M400 240 V420 H600 V240" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="400" y1="300" x2="600" y2="300" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- electrodes -->
  <rect x="120" y="200" width="12" height="212" fill="#888" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="480" y="200" width="12" height="212" fill="#888" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- external circuit with voltmeter above the middle -->
  <path d="M126 200 V80 H298" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M342 80 H486 V200" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="320" cy="80" r="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="320" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">V</text>

  <!-- salt bridge: inverted U tube dipping into both solutions -->
  <path d="M180 370 V220 H460 V370" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="5"/>
  <text x="320" y="262" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">salt bridge</text>

  <!-- electrode labels -->
  <text x="108" y="190" text-anchor="end" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">zinc</text>
  <text x="498" y="190" text-anchor="start" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">copper</text>

  <!-- solution labels -->
  <text x="140" y="448" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">1.0 mol dm<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="11">-3</tspan> ZnSO<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="11">4</tspan>(aq)</text>
  <text x="500" y="448" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">1.0 mol dm<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="11">-3</tspan> CuSO<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="11">4</tspan>(aq)</text>

  <!-- caption -->
  <text x="320" y="500" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#000">Fig. 6.1</text>
</svg>
